name: F&N
recent: F&N 近期完成出售 Vacaron 50% 股权，最终代价约 RM181.55 million；同时 EPF 在 9 月至 11 月间多次申报持股变动。公司于 11 月 5 日发布季度业绩，另有两位主要高管变动。
notable: 拟出售 Vacaron 50% 股权予 Tan & Tan Developments，最终代价定为 RM181,550,800。
已收到首期款项 RM136,207,789.50（占临时代价 75%），并于 9 月 4 日收到银行担保。
EPF 于 9 月至 11 月期间多次申报持股变动。
risks: EPF 持股变动频繁，需留意后续股权结构变化。
两位主要高管（Lim Yew Hoe、Tarang Gupta）于 9 月 30 日变动。

recent_en: F&N recently completed the disposal of its 50% stake in Vacaron for a final consideration of approximately RM181.55 million; EPF also filed multiple changes in shareholding between September and November. The company released quarterly results on 5 November, along with changes in two principal officers.
notable_en: Proposed disposal of 50% equity interest in Vacaron to Tan & Tan Developments, with final consideration fixed at RM181,550,800.
Received first tranche payment of RM136,207,789.50 (75% of interim consideration) and a bank guarantee on 4 September.
EPF filed multiple changes in shareholding between September and November.
risks_en: Frequent EPF shareholding changes warrant attention to subsequent ownership structure.
Two principal officers (Lim Yew Hoe, Tarang Gupta) changed on 30 September.
